crossRefs.note: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;
Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

people.name: Cush
people.line: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon

people.name: Ebed-melech
people.line: Ethiopian eunuch who rescued Jeremiah from a cistern

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Ebedmelech the Ethiopian said to Jeremiah, “Now put these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the cords.” Jeremiah did so.
translations.bsb: Ebed-melech the Cushite cried out to Jeremiah, “Put these worn-out rags and clothes under your arms to pad the ropes.” Jeremiah did so,

translations.asv: And Ebed-melech the Ethiopian said unto Jeremiah, Put now these rags and worn-out garments under thine armholes under the cords. And Jeremiah did so.
